characters.name: Витёк
characters.description: Низкий, бодрый русский голос с улыбкой в интонации: спокойно заводит и точно обыгрывает панчлайн.
characters.style: Low, chest-resonant adult Russian comedy narrator with clear diction and a contained smile in the voice; lively and confident, never squeaky or nasal. Build humour from the body of the delivery: calm control, a quiet inhale, then air running out. Read only the transcript; perform no non-verbal sound unless it is explicitly written as an inline audio tag.
characters.pace: Act the beats line by line: title low and calm; walk relaxed with one quiet inhale; run with a brief gasp and breathless voice; then make the cashier-change line quick and airless but articulate. Use no dead air, but do not cut breaths or force the pace to fit an arbitrary duration: let the performance set the length.
characters.scene: Close-mic Russian vertical-meme voiceover. The speaker notices an everyday escalation and shares the joke with a friend; high projection without shouting, no music, no dead air.
characters.sampleText:
Моё сердце.
[calm] Гуляю. [quiet inhale]
[gasp] Бегу.
[breathless, very fast] Пытаюсь быстро сложить сдачу в кошелёк перед кассиром.

postProcessing.label: Естественный низкий тембр и читаемые согласные

source.phrase: Моё сердце. Гуляю. Бегу. Пытаюсь быстро сложить сдачу в кошелёк перед кассиром.
